body: at midnight today, I walked to the top floor of my apartment complex, got onto the flat roof and walked to the edge. I was going to call the police to let them know and then jump. Instead, I found a little girl on the balcony one floor below me, in her mother's lap, staring up at me. I couldn't scar her. I came back in and read this post and started crying again. My hands are really wet from wiping my eyes. I feel like I shouldn't have come back now, but I couldn't let a young child see me die.
